title: Project Management & Kick-off Meeting (TPM 1)
description: Consortium launch meeting to establish coordination mechanisms, align financial management protocols, finalize internal communication procedures, and calibrate the monitoring and quality assurance framework.
deliverables: Consortium Partnership Agreement signed
Monitoring & Evaluation Plan adopted
Risk Management Protocol established
Internal communication and cloud repository setup
targetAudience: Project managers, coordinators, and youth work leads from DE, TR, and RO

title: Transnational Training Course: Drone Operation, Photography & Video Editing
hostPartner: Integrational e.V. with IESA & Empower Plus
description: An intensive transnational training course bringing together youth workers and youth leaders from the 3 partner countries. Focuses on drone flight regulations (EASA standards), aerial camera operations, environmental flight planning, safety protocols, and cinematic video post-production.
deliverables: Certified cohort of youth drone operators & digital trainers
Field flight exercises capturing real environmental landscapes
Standard operating procedures for youth aerial fieldwork
targetAudience: Youth workers, youth educators, and young digital creators

title: Educational Booklet: Drones & Climate Storytelling
hostPartner: IESA (Lead) with Integrational e.V. & Empower Plus
description: A comprehensive practical handbook providing youth workers and educators with non-formal educational curricula on integrating drone technology, ecological monitoring, ethical aerial photography, and digital climate activism into youth work.
deliverables: Open-access digital publication (PDF)
Curriculum with 10 non-formal learning modules
Drone flight checklist & EU legal compliance guide
targetAudience: European youth organisations, environmental educators, and civil society

title: Three Local Youth Workshops & Field Missions
hostPartner: All Partners in their respective countries
description: Series of localized workshops engaging young people (including youth with fewer opportunities) in hands-on flight simulations, ecological problem-solving, digital media labs, and field documentation of regional climate challenges (deforestation, river basins, urban heat islands).
deliverables: Local youth engaged in hands-on climate media creation
Aerial raw footage repositories collected across 3 countries
Youth-driven local environmental dialogues
targetAudience: Young people aged 16-30, students, local youth with fewer opportunities

title: Youth Climate Action Documentary Series
description: A high-impact, youth-directed multi-episode documentary mini-series presenting aerial views of ecological degradation alongside inspiring grassroots environmental solutions across Germany, Türkiye, and Romania.
deliverables: Full documentary episodes with multi-language subtitles
Teaser trailers and social media micro-reels
Digital distribution package for schools and youth centres
targetAudience: General public, youth across Europe, policymakers, environmental NGOs

title: Hybrid Photo & 360° Virtual Reality (VR) Exhibition
description: A cutting-edge interactive hybrid exhibition featuring drone-captured high-resolution photography and 360-degree immersive panoramas depicting European ecosystems vulnerable to climate impacts.
deliverables: Interactive 360° virtual exhibition web portal
Printable high-resolution photo gallery collection for physical events
Exhibition catalogue with youth reflections
targetAudience: Art and environmental communities, school students, European citizens

title: Dissemination Events & Community Screenings
description: Transnational public dissemination conferences, outdoor film screenings, and roundtables presenting project deliverables to local communities, stakeholders, and European youth networks.
deliverables: Public dissemination conferences in 3 partner countries
Dissemination report and media reach assessment
Policy recommendations brief for youth climate education
targetAudience: Stakeholders, municipal representatives, youth workers, general public

title: Final Transnational Project Meeting & Evaluation (TPM 2)
description: Final consortium assembly to evaluate indicators of achievement, review comprehensive financial documentation, compile final report submissions, and define the long-term exploitation strategy for project outputs.
deliverables: Final Project Evaluation & Monitoring Report
Erasmus+ Final Beneficiary Report documentation
Long-term post-project sustainability pact
targetAudience: Consortium steering committee and partner delegates
